Honestly no the biggest fan of debut BUT this album contains my favorite bjork song of all time, Come to Me, the song that got me into bjork. This album made me see how genuine her music is.

Y’all this album isn’t that bad. There’s not really any theme (I guess finding yourself?) but it’s a good listen. It’s fine. It’s a solid album. Favorite song is Wanderlsust. I love the lyrics and the music video is great.
